attributes.name: NOAA HRRR forecast, 18 hour, fast, virtual
attributes.description: Weather forecasts from the High-Resolution Rapid Refresh (HRRR) model operated by NOAA NWS NCEP. Files are taken from NOAA's NOMADS server as soon as they are published, minutes before NOAA's AWS archive lists them. Only the most recent 3 days of forecasts are kept: the first init_time advances every hour and older forecasts are removed. Use noaa-hrrr-forecast-18-hour-virtual for history.
attributes.attribution: NOAA NWS NCEP HRRR data processed by dynamical.org from NOAA NOMADS.
attributes.time_domain: Forecasts initialized in the most recent 3 days, a moving window
